frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Myopic loss aversion (Benartzi-Thaler): loss aversion plus frequent portfolio evaluation and narrow framing makes equities feel too risky, which Pompian's Ch.19 presents as the solution to the equity-premium puzzle (Mehra-Prescott 6.18%, ~1-year horizon); the chapter also supplies the loss-aversion building block (~2:1, S-shaped value function, disposition effect).
